craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. In-me-always flash; effortless-all seal (treatise lands effortless). Rejected: (a) all→wholly → killed: all is total. Read aloud: SO in-ME you-FLASH, AL-ways … EFF-ort-LESS, ALL.

lines: So in me You flash, always — Consciousness-Bhairava, every being's self —
then rite to mantra's end, complete — effortless, all.
l4.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sphurasi sadā me cidbhairava sarvabhūtātma tad yāgādijapāntaṃ sampannam ayatnataḥ sarvam

reads_against.argmap: How flash effortlessly all? → In-me flashing always; rite accomplished effortlessly.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-vīra of ghoul-girt am-I; amṛta-bhakti of heart-shining; adbhuta of eightfold retinue; mudrā-vīra of sealed all; mudrā-vīra of called seal; vīra of conquering draught; adbhuta of momently rising; śānta of sealed rite
